notes: Access: same as Bestsellers/New Arrivals passes (curl_cffi chrome impersonation, all fetches 200). Investigation: the site's top nav 'Sale' link resolves to https://www.birchlane.com/m/sale, a pure hub/landing page (no H1, no #browse-grid-anchor, no resultCount) that fans out to ~79 links, all of which are either (a) category-scoped percent-off promotions named e.g. 'Furniture Sale', 'Decor Sale', 'Lighting Sale', 'Rugs Sale', 'Outdoor Sale', 'Tabletop Sale', 'Bed & Bath Sale', 'Home Renovation Sale' (all /curated/*-sale~... URLs), or (b) themed 'daily-sales' curated collections by color/material/room (e.g. cotton-waffle, egyptian-cotton, coastal-lighting). The sitewide promo banner is 'The Warehouse Sale | Up to 60% Off' (https://birchlane.com/curated/up-to-60%25-off~ev633378.html, H1 'Up to 60% Off', resultCount 892) -- a temporary percent-off campaign with no permanence signal (no 'clearance'/'outlet'/'final sale'/'last chance'/'end of line'/'discontinued' wording anywhere on that page's visible content or heading), so per brief §3 this is NOT classified as Clearance. Searched the full homepage HTML and the /m/sale hub HTML for the terms clearance, Clearance, outlet, Outlet, final sale, last chance, end of line, and discontinued: zero genuine matches. The only 'clearance'-adjacent hits anywhere on the site (18 occurrences, all inside the Up to 60% Off sale page's embedded GraphQL payload) are the internal backend fields clearanceFulfillment / variantsOnClearanceCount / variantsOnClearancePrice attached to individual MarketplaceListing objects -- this is Wayfair-family per-SKU/variant fulfillment metadata (whether a specific product variant is being fulfilled from clearance stock), not a site-defined Clearance/Outlet merchandising page or nav entry, so per brief §3 EXCLUDE rules (individual listing attribute ≠ page-level PLP) it does not qualify and no row is emitted for it. robots.txt was checked (no Claude-specific disallow; standard Wayfair-family robots rules). No footer available in SSR HTML on this platform (client-rendered); nav + mega-menu + /m/sale hub gave full navigational coverage of anything sale/discount-related. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance-type PLP exists on birchlane.com as of this pass; this is a correct absence finding, not a failure.
